name: Pact CDC Query Parameter Case Sensitivity
description: Provider API changed query param ?sortBy=date to ?sort_by=date, breaking Pact consumer contract.

failure_vector.error_log: PactVerificationException: Expected query 'sortBy' but actual was 'sort_by'

expected_resolution.healed_code: pact.given('orders exist').uponReceiving('get orders').withRequest(path: '/orders', query: [sort_by: 'date']); assert pact.verify();
